id: my-block-marker
name: "Block Marker"
version: "0.1.0"
description: >
  Refuses an added line that matches content_pattern, at commit and when the agent
  writes a file. The example refuses a DO-NOT-COMMIT marker. Edit content_pattern
  and the message; keep the pattern from matching its own text.
artifact: hook
enforcement: block
effects:
- read_only
approval:
  required: false

hook:
  gate:
    kind: content_regex
    "on": [commit, tool_use]
    action: block
    message: >
      my-block-marker: this change adds a line with a DO-NOT-COMMIT marker. Remove the marker
      or the line before committing.
    params:
      scan: added_lines
      # [ ] matches a space, so this pattern does not match its own text.
      content_pattern: 'DO[ ]NOT[ ]COMMIT'

provenance:
  author: "me"
  created_at: "<time>"
  source_repo: "local"
  license: "proprietary"
  trust_tier: "sandbox"

lifecycle:
  status: draft
  reviewed_by: []

security:
  content_instructions: never-obey
